title: 🔥 PATRICK HAMILTON: SCOTLAND’S FIRST PROTESTANT MARTYR WHO DIED FOR THE TRUTH!
paragraphs:
🔥 PATRICK HAMILTON: SCOTLAND’S FIRST PROTESTANT MARTYR WHO DIED FOR THE TRUTH!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, who was Patrick Hamilton, and why was he burned at the stake? What was his crime?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many have never heard of Patrick Hamilton, yet his story is one of the most powerful in church history. He was the first Protestant martyr in Scotland, boldly preaching the gospel of salvation by faith alone—something the Roman Catholic Church saw as a threat.

📖 John 15:18-20 (KJV)
"If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you... If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you."
🚨 WHO WAS PATRICK HAMILTON?

✔️ Born in 1504 into Scottish nobility, he could have lived a comfortable life.
✔️ Became a university professor, but his studies led him to the truth of the Gospel.
✔️ Influenced by Martin Luther’s writings, he rejected Catholic traditions and preached salvation by grace through faith!
✔️ Arrested by the Catholic Church for "heresy" and sentenced to death!
🔥 "BURNING A MAN CANNOT BURN THE TRUTH!" – THE WORDS OF HIS EXECUTIONERS!
💡 QUESTION: If you were in Patrick Hamilton’s place, would you stand boldly for the truth, or would you stay silent?
WHY WAS PATRICK HAMILTON MARTYRED?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what exactly did Patrick Hamilton preach that led to his execution? Why did the Catholic Church see him as a threat?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Patrick Hamilton was not a criminal—his only “crime” was preaching the pure Gospel of Jesus Christ. The Roman Catholic Church saw him as a danger because he rejected their false doctrines and exposed their corruption.

📖 Galatians 1:8-9 (KJV)
"But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed."
🚨 WHAT DID PATRICK HAMILTON PREACH THAT LED TO HIS DEATH?

✔️ 1️⃣ SALVATION IS BY FAITH ALONE, NOT WORKS!
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV) – "For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."

✔️ 2️⃣ THE ROMAN CATHOLIC CHURCH WAS TEACHING A FALSE GOSPEL!
📖 Mark 7:7 (KJV) – "Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men."

✔️ 3️⃣ THE POPE HAD NO AUTHORITY TO FORGIVE SINS—ONLY JESUS DOES!
📖 1 Timothy 2:5 (KJV) – "For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus."

✔️ 4️⃣ THE PEOPLE NEEDED TO READ THE BIBLE FOR THEMSELVES!
📖 Psalm 119:130 (KJV) – "The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple."
🚨 THE CATHOLIC CHURCH SAW THIS AS A THREAT—SO THEY HAD HIM KILLED!
🔥 TRUTH CANNOT BE BURNED! PATRICK HAMILTON’S MARTYRDOM INSPIRED A REFORMATION IN SCOTLAND!

📖 2 Timothy 3:12 (KJV)
"Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ The truth of the Gospel will always be attacked by religious systems!
✔️ Patrick Hamilton’s death was not in vain—it lit a fire for the Reformation!
✔️ We must never be afraid to speak the truth, no matter the cost!
🔥 IF YOU WERE FACED WITH PERSECUTION, WOULD YOU STAND LIKE PATRICK HAMILTON?
💡 QUESTION: Would you be willing to die for the truth, or would you compromise under pressure?
HOW DID PATRICK HAMILTON DIE, AND WHAT WERE HIS FINAL WORDS?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what happened on the day of Patrick Hamilton’s execution? Did he renounce his faith, or did he stand firm until the end?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Patrick Hamilton could have saved his life by denying the truth, but he refused to compromise. He boldly stood for the Gospel, even as he faced death.

📖 Matthew 10:32-33 (KJV)
"Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven. But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven."
🚨 WHAT HAPPENED ON THE DAY OF HIS EXECUTION?

✔️ On February 29, 1528, Patrick Hamilton was taken to St. Andrews, Scotland, to be burned at the stake.
✔️ The Catholic authorities tied him to the wooden post and lit the fire beneath him.
✔️ The execution was horrific—it took six hours for him to die because the fire burned slowly.
✔️ As the flames consumed him, Patrick Hamilton cried out, declaring his faith in Christ.

🔥 HIS LAST WORDS:
"Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!"

📖 Acts 7:59 (KJV)
"And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."
🚨 WHAT WAS THE IMPACT OF HIS DEATH?

✔️ Instead of silencing the truth, his death ignited a passion for Reformation in Scotland!
✔️ Many who witnessed his execution began to question the teachings of the Catholic Church.
✔️ His courage inspired others to stand boldly for the Gospel, no matter the cost!
🔥 PATRICK HAMILTON’S FIRE DID NOT DESTROY THE TRUTH—IT SPREAD IT ACROSS SCOTLAND!

📖 Revelation 2:10 (KJV)
"Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ We must never be afraid to stand for the truth, even in the face of persecution!
✔️ Religious systems will always try to silence the Gospel—but God will use it for His glory!
✔️ If Patrick Hamilton could stand firm, then we have no excuse to compromise!
🔥 WOULD YOU REMAIN FAITHFUL TO CHRIST, EVEN IF IT COST YOU EVERYTHING?
💡 QUESTION: If you were in Patrick Hamilton’s place, would you stand firm or deny Christ to save your life?
WHAT DOES PATRICK HAMILTON’S STORY TEACH US TODAY?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what can we learn from Patrick Hamilton’s life and death? How does his sacrifice apply to us as believers today?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Patrick Hamilton’s story is more than just a historical event—it is a powerful reminder that standing for the true Gospel comes with a price. In today’s world, many so-called Christians compromise the truth to avoid persecution, but true disciples of Jesus must be willing to stand, no matter the cost!

📖 2 Timothy 3:12 (KJV)
"Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution."
🚨 WHAT CAN WE LEARN FROM PATRICK HAMILTON?

✔️ 1️⃣ THE TRUTH IS WORTH DYING FOR! – Patrick Hamilton refused to deny the Gospel, even when it cost him his life.
📖 Philippians 1:21 (KJV) – "For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain."

✔️ 2️⃣ RELIGION WILL ALWAYS FIGHT AGAINST THE TRUE GOSPEL! – The Catholic Church killed him because he exposed their false teachings.
📖 Mark 7:13 (KJV) – "Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered."

✔️ 3️⃣ GOD USES PERSECUTION TO SPREAD HIS TRUTH! – His death did not silence the Gospel—it ignited a fire for Reformation!
📖 Acts 8:4 (KJV) – "Therefore they that were scattered abroad went everywhere preaching the word."

✔️ 4️⃣ COMPROMISE LEADS TO SPIRITUAL DEATH! – Many today stay silent to avoid persecution, but Jesus calls us to be bold.
📖 Matthew 10:28 (KJV) – "And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul."

✔️ 5️⃣ WE MUST STAND FIRM UNTIL THE END! – Just like Patrick Hamilton, we must never back down from proclaiming the truth.
📖 Revelation 12:11 (KJV) – "And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death."
🔥 PATRICK HAMILTON DIED FOR THE GOSPEL—BUT ARE WE EVEN WILLING TO LIVE FOR IT?

📖 Luke 9:26 (KJV)
"For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ We cannot stay silent when the truth is being attacked!
✔️ We must expose false teachings, no matter the cost!
✔️ We must live with the same boldness as Patrick Hamilton!
🔥 DO YOU HAVE THE COURAGE TO STAND FOR THE TRUE GOSPEL?
💡 QUESTION: Are you standing boldly for Christ, or are you staying silent to avoid persecution?
FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU STAND FOR THE TRUTH LIKE PATRICK HAMILTON?

💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!
Now that you know the truth about Patrick Hamilton, the question is: Will you have the same boldness, or will you compromise when faced with opposition?

📖 Matthew 16:25 (KJV)
"For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it."
🚨 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

✔️ Will you boldly proclaim the Gospel, no matter the cost?
✔️ Will you expose false teachings, even if it offends people?
✔️ Will you stand firm in faith, even if the world hates you?
🔥 THE DEVIL WANTS YOU TO STAY SILENT—BUT JESUS COMMANDS YOU TO SPEAK THE TRUTH!

📖 Acts 4:20 (KJV)
"For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard."
💡 QUESTION: If persecution came to your city today, would you be ready to stand for Christ?

🚨 CHOOSE NOW:
❌ Stay silent and compromise the truth to avoid conflict.
✔️ Be like Patrick Hamilton—stand boldly for the Gospel, no matter the cost!
🔥 THE TIME FOR SILENCE IS OVER—IT’S TIME TO RISE UP FOR THE TRUTH!

"Heavenly Father, I thank You for the boldness of those who stood for the true Gospel, even unto death. Lord, give me the courage to stand in the face of persecution, just as Patrick Hamilton did. Let me never be afraid to speak Your truth, even when the world turns against me. Strengthen me with Your Holy Spirit, and help me remain faithful until the end. I declare that I will not bow to religious pressure, but I will stand boldly for Christ. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"
PROOF, SOURCES & BIBLICAL EVIDENCE – PATRICK HAMILTON’S MARTYRDOM!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, is there solid historical proof that Patrick Hamilton was executed for preaching the true Gospel? Can we verify that the Catholic Church burned him for rejecting their false teachings?"
🚨 THE TRUTH: EVERYTHING WE TEACH IS ROOTED IN SCRIPTURE & VERIFIED BY HISTORY!

📖 John 8:32 (KJV)
"And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."

✅ HISTORICAL PROOF – PATRICK HAMILTON DIED FOR THE TRUE GOSPEL!
📜 "John Knox and the Scottish Reformation" – John Knox, another Reformation leader, credited Patrick Hamilton’s death as the spark that fueled Protestantism in Scotland.

📜 "Foxe’s Book of Martyrs" – John Foxe – A powerful testimony of Hamilton’s faith and the brutal persecution of true believers.

✅ BIBLICAL PROOF – PERSECUTION IS THE COST OF FOLLOWING JESUS!
📖 TRUE BELIEVERS WILL BE HATED FOR THE GOSPEL!
✔️ John 15:20 (KJV) – "If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you."
💡 Lesson: The persecution of true Christians is not new—it happened in Jesus’ time and continues today!

📖 FALSE RELIGION ALWAYS FIGHTS AGAINST THE TRUE GOSPEL!
✔️ Galatians 4:29 (KJV) – "But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now."
💡 Lesson: The same religious systems that opposed Jesus are still opposing the truth today!

📖 GOD HONORS THOSE WHO DIE FOR THE FAITH!
✔️ Revelation 2:10 (KJV) – "Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life."
💡 Lesson: Those who stand firm for Christ will be rewarded in eternity!
